title: MemPalace/mempalace
claim: MemPalace/mempalace — The best-benchmarked open-source AI memory system. And it's free.
why_good: Positions as the best-benchmarked open-source memory layer for agents — memory is a real, unsolved need every agent product hits.
value: Sell a hosted/managed memory API + enterprise (retention, multi-tenant) to agent builders who don't want to run it.
risk: Crowded (Mem0, Zep, Letta) and memory may get absorbed into the agent frameworks; 'best benchmark' needs independent proof.

zh.claim: MemPalace/mempalace —— 跑分最好的开源 AI 记忆系统,而且免费。
zh.why_good: 定位为 agent 的跑分最好开源记忆层——记忆是每个 agent 产品都会撞上、且尚未解决的真实需求。
zh.value: 给不想自建的 agent 开发者卖托管记忆 API + 企业版(留存、多租户)。
zh.risk: 很挤(Mem0、Zep、Letta),记忆还可能被 agent 框架吸收;最佳跑分需要独立验证。
zh.hook: 跑分最好的开源 agent 记忆——免费,而且需求是真的。

hook: The best-benchmarked open-source memory for agents — free, and the need is very real.
